acquisitionEvidenceClasses.chat-history: A past Claude chat describes what was downloaded or built. A record of what was done, not an independent check of the source or of its identity.
acquisitionEvidenceClasses.git-history: First-add or last-upload date read from this repository's git history. Dates when the file entered the repo, not necessarily when it was acquired.
acquisitionEvidenceClasses.code-comment: A comment in our own Worker or tools. A claim by earlier sessions.
acquisitionEvidenceClasses.page-read: A page was read in this review (for example a Debian packager's copyright file). The page's statement is recorded; it is not a finding about our extracted copy.
acquisitionEvidenceClasses.none-found: Searched past chats and the repo; no acquisition record surfaced.
acquisitionEvidenceClasses.measured: Our files were compared with the named source's own text (share of 6-word runs in common, spelling and punctuation ignored). Shows the text matches; does not by itself prove it was the download source or settle the licence.
